banner: SYNTHETIC DATA - planted cartels on the citecurv synthetic stream; not a real-data result

controls_A.c_refs_v: out_deg(v): reference count of the cited paper
controls_A.c_indeg_v: in_deg_t(v): citations of v by t (scored row excluded)
controls_A.c_recent_indeg_v: citations of v in (t - W, t] (temporal control, like s_temp)
controls_A.c_refs_u: out_deg(u) - 1: other references of the citing paper
controls_A.c_cocite: co-citation count of (u, v) up to t
controls_A.c_cosine: embedding cosine of u and v

controls_B_extra.b_coupling_share: |refs(u) & refs(v)| / |refs(v)|, 1 if v cites nothing (S2's equivalent)
controls_B_extra.b_transitive: |refs(u) & citers_t(v)|: papers u cites that cite v

curvature_event_time.s1_forman: plan directed Forman screen 2 - in_deg_t(u) - out_deg_t(v)
curvature_event_time.s2_orc_dir: plan directed ORC at t (GraphRicciCurvature convention), closed form
curvature_event_time.s3a_orc_rev: reversed directed ORC: m_u on refs(u), m_v on citers_t(v), undirected metric
curvature_event_time.s4a_orc_undir: undirected ORC on the time-t graph
curvature_event_time.s4b_forman_aug: augmented Forman 4 - deg(u) - deg(v) + 3 triangles (time-t, undirected)
curvature_event_time.s5a_bc_forman: augmented Forman of (u, v) in the bibliographic-coupling graph at t
curvature_event_time.s5b_cc_forman: augmented Forman of (u, v) in the co-citation graph at t
curvature_event_time.s6a_forman_dyn: change of mean plan-Forman of v's incident edges over (t - W, t]
curvature_event_time.s6b_aug_shift: recent minus earlier mean arrival-time augmented Forman of v's in-edges
curvature_event_time.s6c_orc_shift: recent minus earlier mean arrival-time directed ORC of v's in-edges

audit.s7_forman_d365: AUDIT plan Forman at t + 365 d
audit.s7_orc_dir_d365: AUDIT plan directed ORC at t + 365 d
audit.s7_forman_d730: AUDIT plan Forman at t + 730 d
audit.s7_orc_dir_d730: AUDIT plan directed ORC at t + 730 d
audit.a_cocite_d365: AUDIT co-citation count of (u, v) at t + 365 d
audit.a_cocite_d730: AUDIT co-citation count of (u, v) at t + 730 d
